'''Jefris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the early days of the [[SpecForce Incident]], Captain Jefris was sent to find the new [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|commander]] of [[Havoc Squad]], in order to inform the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] about the [[Vanguard advanced training program|vanguard]] and [[commando advanced training program]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Before its removal from the game, Captain Jefris appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the mission giver for the Trooper class's Advanced Class training. He appeared on both [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Carrick Station]], where he sent players to learn from [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Zarkos]].<ref name="TOR" />
